minor_findings: PROOF.md and paper.pdf Section 3 (and inherited main.tex) present the nine 2x2 minors of the normalized parametrization 'in lexicographic row-pair and column-pair order' but the entries at positions (row-pair 12|13 vs 23|12) are interchanged: correct lexicographic array is row2 = (x+c-1, w-1, w-x-c), row3 = (c, w-x-b, xw-(x+b)(x+c)). Both values appear and are positive, and all-nineteen-minors positivity is independently verified, so there is no mathematical impact. Cosmetic only.

Reference [3] cites the Barrett-Johnson paper as 'author manuscript dated May 8, 2026; arXiv:2209.06466'; the consulted PDF is indeed dated May 8, 2026, but a published version exists (Linear Multilinear Algebra, doi:10.1080/03081087.2024.2446784). Attribution is honest; citing the published version would be slightly preferable.

The source-paper eligibility rests on an explicit but informal question (Prop 11 remark + slides 'Problem: Find tight bounds'), not a numbered Problem/Conjecture; MathDB 363360 is a different question and is not resolved. This is judged eligible as the source paper's own optimal-constant question, with the caveat recorded.
